start_rule: First future FORMAL-PRE-RACE race whose immutable FINAL is generated after this preregistration and contains the required frozen MEC/role/pair/third fields.

arm_rules.CORE_ONLY: Purchase frozen CORE tickets only; semantics outside CORE remain informational.
arm_rules.CORE_PROTECTION: Purchase frozen CORE and PROTECTION only; generic TAIL not purchased.
arm_rules.CPSS_ALL: CORE+PROTECTION + all retained trifecta structural exacta/trio closure + soft Global-P3 pair-local exclusion restoration.
arm_rules.CPSS_TOPK: CORE+PROTECTION + soft restoration + structural trio closure only when all three runners are within frozen Static Top-K; K fixed per arm before result.

selection_protocol.during_window: NO ARM SELECTION / NO THRESHOLD TUNING
selection_protocol.after_30: Human review required; compare baseline and all preregistered arms.
